name: Francisca Umejesi Nkeiruka
missingPieces: Capstone D2 did not address Artefact 04, the tampered HS256 token and recovered source secret path.
feedback: Strong work overall: your in-platform write-ups correctly separate encoding from encryption, identify the hash families with their markers, and explain the alg:none JWT failure with the right server-side fix. Your capstone D1 table is well structured and your D3 controls are concrete, mapped to the findings, and cost-aware. The main gap is D2 Artefact 04, which is missing, and that artefact required proving the captured HS256 token was tampered, recovering the real secret from leaked source, and explaining why it was not a normal wordlist crack. For future reports, make sure every required artefact is explicitly handled, especially the honesty traps where the correct answer is to show why a claimed crack or plaintext is not valid. Your board brief is clear and actionable, but the citation row would be stronger with the required CVE reference alongside NIST and OWASP.
